scope: Stage Node writes until Raft apply, replicate Node watch transitions and runtime health
coverage: Failed readiness, deletion and registration proposals preserve committed pointers, files, revision and journal
Transaction body error restores committed Node pointer before any proposal
Committed Node deltas publish on both author and replica
Lease-only renewal does not add a client event
Enrollment persistence failure, retry and reopen retain CIDR and revision
limitations: Concurrent same-Node whole-record writes and ordered watch revisions remain under podster-ucm.2.3.2
Production streamed snapshot artifacts, automatic compaction and startup WAL recovery remain open
Focused suites only; full suite has separately tracked failures
